candidates.concept: An adult polar radio-observatory engineer calibrates a frost-coated low-noise receiver module at an ice-rimed steerable dish, using a handheld spectrum analyzer beside an open waveguide cabinet during cobalt twilight.

An adult polar radio-observatory technician replaces a saturated desiccant cartridge inside an elevated waveguide service cabinet while comparing humidity telemetry on a rugged tablet among snowy antenna gantries.

An adult polar radio-observatory field engineer traces an intermittent phased-array cable fault with a thermal probe and portable receiver while labeled fiber trunks, snow fencing, and distant dipole rows fill the site.

An adult polar radio-observatory maintenance specialist verifies feed alignment with a compact optical gauge and torque log beneath a wind-braced dish, surrounded by iced access platforms and instrument cases.

selection_rule.selector_algorithm: SHA-256(selector_input UTF-8); interpret the first 16 hexadecimal digits as an unsigned integer; selected_index = integer mod candidate_count
